terms.gloss: put, place, or lay under; apply; put in the place of another
evidence: Quint. 1.2.25: id nōbīs ācriōrēs ad studia dīcendī facēs subdidisse (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: put, place, or set under; put in the place of another, substitute
evidence: Cic. ND 2.124: anatum ōva gallīnīs saepe suppōnimus (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: id nōbīs ācriōrēs ad studia dīcendī facēs subdidisse
phrases.english: that this had set keener fires under us for the study of speaking
we often put ducks’ eggs under hens
Line the tin with baking paper.

phrases.latin: inde pānem facitō, folia subditō, in focō caldō sub testū coquitō lēniter
phrases.english: then shape it into a loaf, put leaves underneath, and bake it gently under a crock on a hot hearth
